title: “Amazing, They All Lean Left” – Analyzing the Political Temperaments of Current LLMs
reasoning: The paper's methodology is centered on evaluating the ethical logic of LLMs using Moral Foundations Theory (MFT). It benchmarks how models prioritize specific moral principles such as Care, Fairness, Loyalty, Authority, and Purity, and interprets these findings through the lens of philosophical frameworks like Rawlsian justice and utilitarianism.
